notes: The platform's price sheet — docs/plan/22 § Rating. Read by CyberCloud.Billing.Pricing.PriceSheet.Committed.
A version is in force from its effectiveFrom, which is the first instant of a month in UTC, until the next version's.
⚠ A version whose effectiveFrom has passed is never edited: a price change is a NEW version with a later date. PriceSheetTests.NoVersionInForceHasBeenEdited pins every version in force by hash.
Every BillingMeter is priced in every version, at zero if it is free; an unpriced meter would be usage nobody is charged for.
Tiers are per subscription, per meter, per calendar month; upTo is the cumulative monthly quantity a tier ends at, and the last tier has none. A first tier at 0.0 is the meter's monthly free tier.
StorageGbMonths is rated on the DECLARED size — docs/plan/22 § What is owed, storage-is-declared-not-observed. BackupGbMonths is whatever the provider that emits it measured.
